name: The Booker Prize
description: The leading literary award in the English-speaking world, awarded annually for the best sustained work of fiction written in English and published in the UK or Ireland.

name: The Pulitzer Prize for Fiction
description: Awarded for distinguished fiction by an American author, preferably dealing with American life.

name: National Book Award for Fiction
description: Celebrates the best literature published in the United States, judged by independent panels of accomplished writers.

name: Women's Prize for Fiction
description: One of the most prestigious literary prizes in the world, awarded annually to a woman of any nationality for a full-length novel in English.

name: International Booker Prize
description: Awarded annually for a single book translated into English and published in the UK or Ireland, splitting the prize equally between author and translator.

name: International Dublin Literary Award
description: One of the world's richest literary prizes for a single work of fiction, with nominations submitted by public libraries worldwide.

name: The Goldsmiths Prize
description: Rewards fiction that breaks the mould or extends the possibilities of the novel form.

name: Hugo Award for Best Novel
description: The premier award for science fiction and fantasy literature, voted on by members of the World Science Fiction Convention.

name: Nebula Award for Best Novel
sponsor: Science Fiction and Fantasy Writers Association (SFWA)
description: Awarded annually by SFWA to recognize the best speculative fiction published in the United States.

name: Nobel Prize in Literature
description: The world's highest international honor in literature, awarded to an author for their lifetime body of work and profound contribution to the human spirit.

name: National Book Critics Circle Award for Fiction
description: Selected by an elected board of nearly thirty practicing book reviewers and critics across America.

name: James Tait Black Prize for Fiction
description: Awarded annually by the University of Edinburgh for the best work of fiction published in the previous year.

name: James Tait Black Prize for Biography
description: Awarded annually by the University of Edinburgh for the best biography published in the previous year.

name: James Tait Black Prize for Drama
description: Awarded by the University of Edinburgh for the best original new play written in English, Scots or Gaelic and performed by a professional company.

name: PEN/Faulkner Award for Fiction
description: Awarded annually to the best work of fiction by a living American citizen, chosen by a panel of peer writers.

name: Prix Goncourt
description: France's most prestigious literary award, presented annually by the Académie Goncourt to the best and most imaginative prose work of the year.

name: PEN/Hemingway Award for Debut Novel
description: Honors a distinguished first novel or book of short stories by an American author who has not previously published a book of fiction.

name: Edgar Allan Poe Award for Best Novel
description: The premier honor in mystery and crime fiction, presented annually by the Mystery Writers of America for the best mystery novel published in the US.

name: World Fantasy Award for Best Novel
description: Presented annually at the World Fantasy Convention to recognize outstanding achievement in fantasy and dark speculative literature.

name: Miles Franklin Literary Award
description: Australia's premier literary prize, awarded annually to a novel of the highest literary merit which presents Australian life in any of its phases.

name: Scotiabank Giller Prize
description: Canada's premier literary prize for fiction, awarded annually to the best Canadian novel or short story collection published in English.

name: Kirkus Prize for Fiction
description: One of the richest literary awards in the world, recognizing exceptional fiction published over the previous year that earned a starred Kirkus review.
